snippet.title: BrokenLore: Follow - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: FOLLOW is coming 1st June 2026 to PlayStation 5

BrokenLore: FOLLOW is psychological first-person horror experience that follows Anne, a young woman haunted by her painful past. In the prequel to BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW, Anne confronts her childhood traumas as she encounters surreal finds herself facing manifestations of her past memories and experiences. 

#ps5 #ps5games #brokenlore
